--Read the nested CSV file structure
df = spark.read.option("header", "true") \
               .csv("abfss://newyorkrawdata@synapseadlsrav1.dfs.core.windows.net/trip_data_green_csv/year=2020/month=*/*.csv")

--Limit records to prevent massive files, then select core columns to mock the project logic
df_subset = df.select("VendorID", "lpep_pickup_datetime", "passenger_count", "trip_distance", "total_amount") \
              .limit(5000)

--Coalesce to 1 file so it mirrors a single minified document (similar to Amazon_1-level_1-KB_minified.json)
df_subset.coalesce(1).write \
         .mode("overwrite") \
         .json("abfss://newyorkrawdata@synapseadlsrav1.dfs.core.windows.net/trip_data_green_json/nyc_taxi_minified.json")
